title: Product Owner
description:
ENGLISH RESUMES ONLY


JOB DESCRIPTION

The Product Owner (PO) for the Revenue Management System (RMS) is responsible for shaping and delivering integrated solutions that support pricing, demand forecasting, and revenue optimization. This role involves managing initiatives that span data engineering, machine learning, and user-facing interfaces. In addition to gathering and managing business requirements, the PO will be responsible for overseeing the full delivery lifecycle to ensure successful execution from concept through release.


DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Develop and maintain a backlog of features and enhancements spanning data pipelines, predictive models, and RMS user interfaces.

Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities to optimize pricing strategies and demand forecasting.

Gather, analyze, and document business requirements and translate them into detailed epics and user stories with clear descriptions, business rules, and acceptance criteria.

Own the full delivery lifecycle of features and enhancements, ensuring timely execution, alignment with stakeholders, and readiness for deployment.

Collaborate with Data Engineering on requirements for data sourcing, integration, and quality.

Partner with Data Science to define, deploy, and iterate on ML models and pricing algorithms.

Align with UI/UX and front-end teams to ensure a seamless user experience.

Facilitate cross-functional workshops and planning sessions with business stakeholders.

Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess product success and user adoption.

Ensure accurate documentation in Confluence and Jira for themes, epics, and tasks.

Coordinate with QA to validate features and ensure delivery meets requirements.

Promote continuous iteration based on stakeholder feedback and performance data.

Drive change management and support user training for new RMS features.

Ensure compliance with data governance, security, and regulatory standards.

Identify and mitigate risks associated with process and system changes.

Actively participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.

Perform other job-related functions as assigned.


QUALIFICATIONS

DEGREE TYPE:

Bachelor's Degree


FIELD(S) OF STUDY:

Business Management, Data Analytics, or related fields


EXPERIENCE;

  • At least 3 years of experience in end-to-end product ownership, product management, or delivery of data or optimization platforms.
  • Experience working across Data Engineering, Data Science, and UI Development teams, as well with multiple stakeholders and brand Revenue Management teams.
  • Experience working in Agile software development environments with cross-functional teams.
  • Industry experience in cruise, travel, or enterprise data systems is a plus.


COMPETENCIES/SKILLS

  • Exposure to revenue management, pricing systems, or forecasting tools is preferred
  • Strong understanding of Agile delivery methodologies and iterative development
  • Familiarity with data pipelines, ML model lifecycle, and modern UI patterns
  • Ability to define and refine user stories across technical and business domains
  • Proficient in Jira, Confluence, and backlog management tools
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Excellent facilitation, documentation, and analytical skills
  • Understanding of change management principles and user adoption strategies
  • High attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities
  • Strong business acumen and problem-solving capabilities
  • Adaptability in fast-paced, cross-functional environments


CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSES

Add certifications/licenses (if any) here.

  • Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar Agile certification preferred
  • Product Management or Lean Six Sigma certification is a plus

title: IT Operations Manager
description:
We are the Americas Cluster Operations Team, a critical component of a leading global technology enterprise's infrastructure strategy. Our mission is to ensure the highly efficient, stable, and secure operation of the operational environment across the Americas. Our team comprises dedicated professionals in Facilities, IT, and Asset Management, deeply experienced in large-scale system operations, possessing comprehensive capabilities from daily operations to strategic planning:Facilities Team: Responsible for 24x7 uninterrupted operations and emergency response of critical physical support systems within the large operational environment, including electrical, HVAC, and fire suppression. We ensure physical environment stability and sustainable operations through rigorous capacity management and energy efficiency optimization.IT Team: Manages the full lifecycle operations of IT equipment like servers and networks within the operational environment. We ensure high SLA compliance for IT services through proactive systemic risk governance, automation, and process optimization, while leading various technology upgrade projects.Asset Team: Oversees the full lifecycle management and governance of IT assets. We ensure asset compliance, visibility, and efficient utilization through precise data management, risk control, and cost-efficiency strategies.Our Core Focuses:End-to-End Reliability: From physical support to IT services, we provide comprehensive stability assurance, focused on mitigating risks and ensuring business continuity.Project-Based & Lean Operations: We approach operational work through a project lens, continuously optimizing processes to achieve efficient resource utilization and lean operating costs.Innovation & Talent Development: We actively integrate cutting-edge technologies and foster robust knowledge-sharing mechanisms to continuously enhance our team's professional capabilities and innovative practices.We serve as the robust foundation for the enterprise's business growth in the Americas, providing powerful and trustworthy infrastructure assurance through professionalism, innovation, and collaboration.


Job Responsibilities:

1. Responsible for the comprehensive operation and maintenance management of IT infrastructure (including but not limited to servers, networks, storage, and related software platforms) within large-scale operational environments in the Americas region.

2. Develop and implement IT operation strategies, procedures, and standards (SOPs) to ensure the efficient, stable, and secure operation of IT systems, in compliance with internal and external regulations.

3. Manage the IT operations team, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, team development, and daily management, to enhance team professionalism and efficiency.

4. Lead IT incident management, event response, change management, and problem-solving processes to ensure high availability and business continuity of IT systems.

5. Drive the IT operations' transformation towards automation and intelligence, introducing advanced technologies and tools to continuously optimize operational processes, efficiency, and quality.

6. Responsible for IT infrastructure capacity planning, performance monitoring, and optimization to ensure resource allocation meets business growth demands.

7. Manage IT-related vendors and third-party service providers, ensuring their service quality and SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance.

8. Responsible for IT operations budget planning, cost control, and analysis of technology investment returns.

9. Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams (e.g., Facilities, Asset Management, Security, Business Units) to ensure IT operations effectively support overall business objectives.

10. Stay abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies, supporting the evolution of IT architecture to enhance technological competitiveness.



Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Network Engineering, Electronic Information Engineering, or a related IT professional field.

2. Over 5 years of experience in large-scale IT system operation and maintenance management, with at least 3 years in a team management role; experience in multinational corporations is a plus.

3. In-depth understanding and practical experience with server hardware, operating systems (Linux/Windows), network technologies (TCP/IP, routing & switching), and storage systems.

4. Familiar with ITIL/ITSM management frameworks, possessing excellent capabilities in ITIL process implementation and optimization.

5. Practical experience with IT automation and intelligent operation tools (e.g., scripting languages, monitoring systems, configuration management tools).

6. Excellent team leadership, project management, and risk management capabilities.

7. Outstanding communication, coordination, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, capable of handling complex technical and managerial issues.

8. Strong English reading, writing, and communication skills, able to communicate effectively as a working language.

9. (Plus) Relevant professional certifications such as ITIL, PMP, CCIE/CCNP, RHCE are a plus.

10. (Plus) Experience in cloud platform operations or DevOps practices is a plus.

title: Analista de Business Development
description:
Quem somos nós

Na Amaris Consulting , acreditamos que a tecnologia deve servir às pessoas — e não o contrário. Somos uma consultoria independente de tecnologia e gestão que apoia empresas em seus projetos de transformação em todo o mundo.

  • Realizar um mapeamento de clientes/ofertas, tecnologias e competências do mercado com o apoio de outros departamentos internos do Grupo.

  • Abrir novas contas, gerenciando aspectos legais e contratuais.


Gestão Financeira

  • Analisar e otimizar o Profit & Loss (P&L), calculando margens.
  • Realizar análises avançadas de rentabilidade, identificar oportunidades de melhoria e elaborar planos de ação para otimizar faturamento e margem contributiva.
  • Gerenciar temas relacionados à recuperação de créditos.


Gestão de Equipe

  • Contribuir na elaboração e análise de planos de negócios.
  • Acompanhar e apoiar o desenvolvimento das pessoas-chave da equipe.
  • Propor e implementar novos processos e iniciativas de melhoria.


Recursos Humanos

  • Participar do recrutamento e da gestão da equipe de consultores (prospecção, entrevistas, relatórios, assinatura de contratos etc.).
  • Acompanhar o desenvolvimento de carreira da equipe (atribuição de funções, avaliações, envolvimento de talentos-chave etc.).

Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B, com histórico de cumprimento ou superação de metas.
  • Experiência com mercado de tecnologia.
  • Forte entendimento das técnicas de vendas e do ambiente corporativo B2B.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e negociação.
  • Fluência em português e inglês.
  • Formação superior completa.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.


O que oferecemos

  • Um ambiente internacional com oportunidades reais de crescimento.
  • A possibilidade de atuar diretamente com clientes de diferentes países (Estados Unidos e Europa).
  • Presença em São Paulo, Curitiba e Rio de Janeiro , com oportunidades de realocação entre projetos .
  • Um modelo de negócio sólido e sustentável, com crescimento anual de 45% e mais de 400 projetos ativos no Brasil .
  • Uma cultura que valoriza o acompanhamento individual, o desenvolvimento de competências e a formação contínua .
  • Uma abordagem centrada nas pessoas — sem bodyshopping , com foco em carreira e evolução profissional .


Na Amaris Consulting, promovemos um ambiente inclusivo e valorizamos a diversidade. Todas as candidaturas são consideradas sem distinção de gênero, origem, religião, orientação sexual, deficiência ou idade.

About Star Charge:

Star Charge is a global leader in electric vehicle charging equipment manufacturing and charging network operation. We are committed to building a worldwide new energy mobility service network through innovative technology and services. We are actively expanding into the South American market and seeking a visionary and experienced leader

to drive the full-scale development of our business in the region from zero to one and beyond.


Position Summary:

As the General Manager for the South America Region, you will be fully responsible for developing and executing the overall strategy for Star Charge in South America, achieving rapid growth in market share, revenue, and profitability. You will be the business founder and core leader, establishing local operations, managing government relations, strategic partnerships, market expansion, sales delivery, and service operations.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Strategy & Planning:

Develop long-term market development strategy, annual business plans, and financial budgets for the South America region. Conduct in-depth analysis of policy environments, competitive landscapes, customer needs, and industry trends in key South American

countries (e.g., Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Argentina). Identify market opportunities and potential risks, formulating corresponding market entry and competitive strategies.

2. Business Development & Sales:

Lead and personally engage in acquiring, negotiating with, and maintaining relationships with key clients (e.g., OEMs, energy companies, large commercial real estate, retail chains, government projects). Establish and manage a diversified sales channel network, including direct sales, distributors, and strategic partners. Lead major project bidding to ensure regional sales and market share targets are achieved.

3. Operations & Localization Management:

Oversee the daily operations of the South American subsidiary. Establish and optimize the local team structure, business processes, financial and compliance systems. Supervise the construction, operation, and maintenance quality of the charging network, ensuring excellent user experience and service reliability.

4. Government Relations & Public Affairs:

Represent the company to build and maintain strong relationships with government bodies, industry associations, and media across South American countries. Closely monitor and proactively influence policies and standards related to EVs and charging infrastructure.

5. Team Building & Leadership:

Recruit, develop, motivate, and manage a high-performing local team, fostering a positive and efficient organizational culture. Act as the bridge between the regional team and global headquarters, ensuring strategic alignment and resource synergy.


Qualifications & Requirements:

1. Education & Experience:

Bachelor's degree or above; MBA, Engineering, Economics, or related field preferred. Minimum 10 years of professional experience, with at least 5 years in a general management or senior business development role in South America. Experience in new energy, automotive, energy infrastructure, industrial products, or technology sectors is highly preferred. Proven track record of successfully building a new market or business line from scratch.

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
Vaga: Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior – Modelo Híbrido


Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sr com visão moderna, apaixonado(a) por tecnologia, inovação e pelo uso de Inteligência Artificial no desenvolvimento de soluções.

Se você busca desafios reais, autonomia e a chance de criar produtos que impactam milhares de pessoas, essa vaga é para você!


Atividades e Responsabilidades

Apoio técnico ao Product Manager, essencial execução de demandas de codificação e resolução de bloqueios junto ao time de desenvolvimento.


Principais Responsabilidades:


1. Desenvolvimento e Implementação: Você será responsável por desenvolver e implementar aplicações web de alta qualidade utilizando ReactJS/Vue.js, .NET e NodeJS. Você deverá garantir que todas as aplicações sejam performáticas, escaláveis e mantidas adequadamente.


2. Construção de Componentes: Você será responsável por criar componentes reutilizáveis e funcionalidades para proporcionar a melhor experiência possível para o usuário. Isso inclui a construção, evolução e escalamento de arquiteturas distribuídas e micro serviços.


3. Code Review: Uma parte significativa de sua função será a participação em revisões de código para garantir a qualidade do código, a aplicação das melhores práticas e a eficiência na resolução de problemas.


4. Melhorias Contínuas: Você deverá propor constantemente melhorias nas soluções existentes para propiciar melhor desempenho, bem como acompanhar as novidades tecnológicas do ecossistema e proativamente sugerir mudanças que podem melhorar o processo de desenvolvimento. Isso pode incluir a adoção de novas ferramentas, técnicas de automação ou melhores práticas.


5. Implementação de CI/CD: Como parte do foco na eficiência e qualidade, você será responsável pela implementação de práticas de Integração Contínua e Entrega Contínua (CI/CD).


6. Testes: O desenvolvimento e aplicação de testes automatizados para garantir a qualidade e a integridade das aplicações serão uma parte fundamental de suas responsabilidades.


Requisitos

1. Experiência prévia comprovada em posição similar.

2. Proficiência em .NET, Vue.js/ReactJS e NodeJS.

3. Experiência com TypeScript.

4. Experiência com banco de dados relacional e não relacional.

5. Conhecimento com APIs REST.

6. Experiência com ferramentas de testes como Jest e Cypress.

7. Experiência em Docker e conteinerização de aplicações.

8. Experiência com sistemas de versionamento (Git) e pipelines de CI/CD.

9. Experiência com micro serviços e comunicação assíncrona com MQ (Ex: RabbitMQ)

10. Conhecimento em estratégias de cache.

11. Conhecimento em DevOps e plataformas Cloud (Azure).

12. Conhecimento sólido em princípios do desenvolvimento de software, como design patterns, SOLID, e melhores práticas para softwares escaláveis.

13. Experiência em modelagem de domínio com DDD.

14. Excelente comunicação e habilidades de colaboração.

15. Conhecimento dos riscos comuns de segurança (OWASP).

16. Conhecimento em estratégias de monitoramento.


Diferenciais:

Conhecimentos em tecnologias de Inteligência Artificial no ambiente Azure ou GCP serão considerados um grande diferencial.

title: Analista de Projetos e Processo Pl.
description:
Sobre a Lockton

Fundada há mais de 50 anos por Jack Lockton em Kansas City, a Lockton desenvolveu uma marca internacionalmente reconhecida pela qualidade e eficiência nos serviços que oferecemos. Graças a lealdade de nossos clientes, que nos permitiu crescer expressivamente nos últimos anos, a Lockton hoje está entre as maiores corretoras de seguro do mundo, conquistando a taxa de crescimento orgânico mais rápida do mercado de corretoras


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

  • Planejar, executar e monitorar projetos utilizando boas práticas do PMBOK/PMI.
  • Elaborar e gerenciar documentos e artefatos de projetos, como TAP (Termo de Abertura do Projeto), EAP/WBS, cronogramas, matriz RACI, planos de comunicação e gestão de riscos e issues.
  • Acompanhar fases de testes (UAT), readiness e go-live, garantindo alinhamento entre áreas envolvidas e qualidade das entregas.
  • Monitorar prazos, escopo, riscos e dependências, propondo planos de ação para mitigação de desvios.
  • Mapear, analisar e redesenhar processos utilizando metodologias como BPMN 2.0, AS-IS e TO-BE.
  • Conduzir análises de processos por meio de ferramentas como SIPOC, VSM e desenho de fluxos ponta a ponta.
  • Elaborar e manter procedimentos, fluxos, políticas e controles operacionais, garantindo padronização e clareza para as áreas usuárias.
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua com foco em eficiência, qualidade e redução de desperdícios.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de gestão de demandas e projetos, como Jira, para acompanhamento de atividades, status e indicadores.
  • Apoiar a organização e atualização da documentação de projetos e processos, garantindo rastreabilidade e governança.
  • Atuar com conceitos de Lean Six Sigma aplicados à melhoria de processos.
  • Apoiar auditorias de processos, padronização (SOPs) e iniciativas de governança.
  • Garantir que projetos e processos considerem requisitos de LGPD, com noções de privacidade e segurança da informação.
  • Planejar e executar ações de change management, incluindo plano de adoção, comunicação e engajamento dos stakeholders.
  • Conduzir treinamentos, capacitações e suporte aos usuários no pós-go-live, assegurando correta utilização dos processos e sistemas implementados.
  • Atuar em projetos envolvendo sistemas de negócio, como CRM e ERP (ex.: Ploomes, Salesforce, SAP).
  • Apoiar iniciativas relacionadas a processos comerciais, integrando áreas de negócio e tecnologia.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

Ensino superior completo em áreas de Tecnologia, Processos ou Negócios (Engenharia de Produção, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Administração, Análise de Sistemas ou correlatas).

Desejável pós-graduação/MBA ou certificações em Projetos, Processos, Qualidade ou Métodos Ágeis (PMP/PMI, CBPP/ABPMP, Lean Six Sigma, Scrum/Agile).

Inglês e Espanhol avançado/fluente, com capacidade para conduzir reuniões, elaborar documentos e apresentar status a públicos executivos.

Experiência em gestão de projetos do planejamento ao go-live.

Vivência em mapeamento e melhoria de processos, com visão ponta a ponta.

Experiência com ferramentas de gestão, como Jira.

Atuação em padronização, governança, qualidade e gestão da mudança.

Desejável experiência em CRM/ERP (ex.: Ploomes, Salesforce, SAP) e processos comerciais.

title: Project Analyst (Petroleum Exploration & Production)
description:
Project Analyst (Petroleum Exploration & Production)

Curitiba/PR, Brazil


Position type: Full-Time, in-person

Reports to: Regional Director, IPA-LA

Date posted: February 11, 2026

Closing date: Open until filled


Introduction

Are you interested in how the oil and gas Exploration & Production (E&P) world is transitioning? Do you love making connections and solving puzzles or problems? Are you detailed and focused, yet you also have broad interests and ideas and excellent communication skills? Do you enjoy analytical research work while also being comfortable client-facing?


If so, please apply as a Project Analyst – Petroleum Exploration & Production in IPA’s Latin America office! The Project Analyst will lead evaluations and consulting for major energy players to help them improve the effectiveness of their capital projects.


About the Role

Independent Project Analysis (IPA) has an opening position in our Latin America office (located in Curitiba/PR, Brazil) for a Project Analyst – Petroleum Exploration & Production . The candidate should have a proven track record working on capital projects or analyzing project feasibility in the upstream oil & gas market. Candidates are required to have strong analytical skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to contribute as a thought leader. Aptitude for and demonstrated skills to be a successful analyst include your ability to connect in real life with the data and vice versa, to know when to ask more questions and when to just listen, as well as to be self-motivated to learn and thrive.


IPA’s client portfolio includes world-leading companies in both the heavy and light industries around the world. IPA has offices in the United States, the United Kingdom, The Netherlands, Australia, Brazil, and Singapore; as such, major industry leaders globally rely on us to assess the health of their capital project systems and provide recommendations to improve their performance. IPA evaluates hundreds of capital projects every year, developing very complete technical, business, and people histories from their front-end through early operation. These histories become the data we use to find what works and what does not work in capital projects. The IPA project databases are unique and the most comprehensive sources of capital project experience in existence. IPA also takes a leading role in empirical research into the drivers of better projects and project systems using our extensive databases of past project performance.


Responsibilities

General responsibilities of the role include:

  • Working directly with capital project teams and project organizations of major E&P companies to improve business competitiveness
  • Interfacing with clients to collect and analyze technical, cost, schedule, and project management data
  • Writing reports with insight and a customer focus
  • Delivering verbal feedback and public presentations
  • Conducting research on the drivers of project success or failure using proprietary databases and statistics


Day in the Life

Responsibilities of the Project Analyst – Petroleum Exploration & Production role include:

  • Interfacing directly with clients in person to collect project data and uncover areas of risk
  • Applying statistical analysis to quantify your findings
  • Writing reports to provide insight and recommendations for clients
  • Delivering verbal feedback and presentations to technical and business audiences
  • Working directly with capital project teams and project organizations of major E&P companies to improve business competitiveness
  • Conducting research on drivers of project success and failure using IPA’s proprietary databases and statistics


Skills and Qualities

Project Analysts – Petroleum Exploration & Production must have:

  • Demonstrable Portuguese and English language oral and written communication skills; fluency in Spanish is an advantage
  • Solid analytical skills
  • Ability to demonstrate intellectual curiosity and organizational leadership
  • Excellent listening, presentation, and report writing skills with strong attention to detail
  • Strong interpersonal skills to develop and maintain relationships at senior levels with client companies and liaise with people from other cultures
  • Strong work ethic
  • High self-motivation and ability to work independently
  • Positive attitude and willingness to work in a team
  • Ability to work to tight deadlines and under pressure
  • Flexibility in taking on a variety of assignments


Travel

  • This position requires up to 30 percent travel; candidates are required to have proper documentation for necessary business travel
  • Travel will be required primarily within Latin America and is primarily on weekdays


Education and Experience

  • A Master’s degree (preferred) or Bachelor’s degree or the equivalent in engineering, science (physics, chemistry, petroleum, geology), statistics, operations research, economics, or related fields
  • Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience with upstream oil and gas projects
  • Proven record of carrying out independent research or using a variety of statistical methods to analyze large amounts of data


WHY IPA?

For over 35 years, IPA has delivered groundbreaking research and quantitative risk analyses to enhance the value generated by our clients’ capital project systems and meet their obligations for sustainable and safe performance. IPA guides capital‑intensive organizations to establish the right combination of people, work process, and governance to maximize performance across several measures: cost, schedule, safety, operability performance, and carbon reduction. We have a dataset of over 24,000 capital projects as the basis of our work. Our clients are leading companies in the energy, minerals, infrastructure, chemicals, pharmaceutical, and consumer products sectors. IPA is committed to social and ethical responsibility, and all global offices initiate or participate in local charity initiatives to support those in need .


HOW TO APPLY

Applicants should complete the form at and include a cover letter, resume, and salary requirement.

title: Account Manager
description:
Altenar is an international IT company founded in 2011, with offices in Malta, Greece, Georgia, the Isle of Man, Uruguay and Brazil. We specialize in high-load software development and provide one of the best technology solutions for the iGaming industry worldwide.


The vacancy is remote and the candidate should be based in Belo Horizonte. The role may require occasional travelling in Brazil.

Please, submit your CV in English when applying for this vacancy.


Role Overview

We are seeking a proactive, passionate, and dedicated Account Manager to act as the main point of contact between our clients and internal teams. The ideal candidate will have a strong focus on client satisfaction, relationship management, and operational excellence, ensuring that each client receives outstanding support and value from our products and services.


Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary contact for client needs, inquiries, and concerns.
  • Build and nurture strong client relationships to foster retention and growth.
  • Oversee client accounts, ensuring services meet business goals, expectations, and budgets.
  • Collaborate with internal teams — including sales, product, and operations — to deliver tailored solutions.
  • Proactively identify and resolve issues, continuously improving client experience and internal processes.
  • Work closely with the product team to align updates and features with client expectations.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of Altenar’s offerings to identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling.
  • Act as a trusted advisor and advocate for clients, ensuring a seamless and positive partnership.


Requirements & Skills:

  • Languages: Portuguese (proficient), English (intermediate or higher).
  • Previous experience in account management, sales, or customer service .
  • Strong multitasking and organizational skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to collect, track, and interpret data effectively.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
  • Problem-solving attitude and adaptability in fast-paced environments.
  • Proven ability to build rapport and collaborate with diverse teams.
  • Experience in the sports betting or iGaming industry is a strong advantage.


What We Offer

  • A stable, flexible, and collaborative working environment.
  • Ongoing training and professional development opportunities.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • A multinational team of industry experts from around the world.

title: Líder de Equipe Comercial Externo - Mercado Pago -Paraná
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio, o dinheiro e os pagamentos na América Latina.


Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico.

Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.


Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:


  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.


Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:


  • Liderar time de 10 executivos hunters responsável por adquirir e desenvolver o relacionamento com empresas varejistas e prestadores de serviço com faturamento superior a R$ 30 mil.
  • Desenvolver uma equipe de talentos, potencializando seu resultado a partir da excelência na execução, melhor experiência para os usuários, estratégias comerciais e um excelente clima.
  • Colaborar para o desenvolvimento da proposta de valor e estratégia do segmento.


Requisitos:


  • Possuir formação superior completa ou estar cursando.
  • Ter experiência consistente de vendas em empresas adquirentes ou de entregas porta a porta.
  • Conhecer profundamente a região de atuação;
  • Experiência consistente em liderar equipes comerciais;
  • Possuir CNH "B” e Automóvel próprio (4 rodas) para uso diário;
  • Estar disponível para trabalhar na região de atuação; Pato Branco, Francisco Beltrão

title: Compensation & Benefits Manager | Affirmative Position (Ethnicity & PwD)
description:
ABOUT COTY


Coty is one of the world's largest beauty companies, with an iconic portfolio of fragrance, color cosmetics, skincare, and body care brands. They celebrate and foster a culture of kindness and pride themselves on offering equal opportunities. Coty believes that beauty is found in diversity and is committed to creating an environment where every talent shines, valuing the unique contributions each individual brings to the team. As part of their commitment to inclusion, all profiles are welcome at Coty.

Join Coty and be part of a dynamic team dedicated to shaping the future of the beauty industry in Latin America through a unique footprint. Apply now to contribute your expertise and passion for technology and to drive digital transformation into our business success!


JOB OVERVIEW


This is an affirmative position for Black and People with Disabilities (PwD) candidates. This is a role for someone ready to take the next step. As a Compensation & Benefits Manager, you will lead a team, own key C&B processes, and play a critical role in building the governance and structures that support our people strategy connecting data, business needs, and human decisions.


You will act as a trusted partner and mediator, bridging HR, Finance, and business areas ensuring that C&B processes run smoothly, decisions are well-grounded, and communication with leaders, HRBPs, and employees is always clear and consistent.


You will ensure that our compensation structures and benefits packages are competitive, compliant, and aligned with organizational strategy, while building a team culture of rigor, collaboration, and continuous improvement.


RESPONSIBILITIES


  • Lead, develop, and engage your team fostering autonomy, accountability, and technical growth in each team member;
  • Design and sustain global compensation processes that support performance, equity, and talent retention;
  • Conduct compensation benchmarking analyses and present results to global stakeholders, supporting informed decisions on salary structures;
  • Partner with leadership to review and adjust salary structures, acting as a key mediator between business needs and HR governance;
  • Develop and maintain policies, guidelines, and processes for C&B, ensuring clarity and consistency across the organization;
  • Create communication and training materials that help leaders, HRBPs, and employees navigate C&B practices with confidence;
  • Manage comprehensive benefits programs (healthcare, dental, wellbeing, and non-monetary benefits), including end-to-end vendor and supplier management, from contract negotiations to ongoing relationship governance;
  • Continuously evaluate the effectiveness of benefits programs, bringing a critical eye to what works and proposing data-driven improvements;
  • Monitor healthcare claims ratio (loss ratio) through monthly analyses and lead preventive and corrective actions in partnership with the health area to optimize costs and strengthen contractual negotiations;
  • Ensure full compliance of C&B programs with labor legislation and local regulations;
  • Keep C&B records current and accurate, preparing reports that meet internal and external audit standards;
  • Own and control all personnel costs, including annual budget, forecasting, monthly business review reporting, efficiency initiatives, labor capitalization, and provisions;
  • Ensure transparent and reliable information flow with leadership, the team, and HRBPs, building trust through clarity and consistency.


REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS


Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Human Resources, or related fields;

Good experience of compensation and benefits practices, market references, and local regulations;

Previous experience leading teams;

Strong analytical profile, comfortable with data, budgets, and process structuring;

Strong communication and negotiation skills, you can influence without imposing, and mediate without losing direction;

Organized, detail-oriented, and able to think systemically, keeping multiple fronts moving without losing the bigger picture;

Availability to work in a hybrid model (2 days per week on-site);

Advanced English (mandatory);

High energy, ownership mindset, and genuine drive to grow, this role is a real opportunity to build your management career in a structured, meaningful environment.

title: Collections Analyst
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay . CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.


Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.


About the Job

We're looking for a Collections Agent to join our Operations Team. As a Collections Agent you will be responsible for executing hands-on collections activities to ensure timely recovery of overdue payments while maintaining professional relationships with SME customers. You will work directly with active cases, contacting customers and following up on overdue payments. The role plays a key part in reducing early-stage delinquency and supporting healthy cash flow across Credix’s portfolio.


Qualifications

  • 1–2 year of experience in collections, accounts receivable, customer service, call centers, or operational roles.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.
  • Comfortable communicating with customers via phone, WhatsApp, and email.
  • The ability to handle multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail.
  • Comfortable working with basic data (SQL), Excel, internal tools, and spreadsheets.
  • Willingness to learn and grow within the role.
  • Collaborative mindset work seamlessly with cross-functional teams.
  • Interest in fintech, operations, or financial services.


Responsibilities

  • Contact customers according to defined schedules and scripts via phone, WhatsApp, and email.
  • Develop and utilize communication scripts to negotiate.
  • Follow up on overdue payments and payment promises, ensuring timely actions aligned with the delinquency cycle (e.g., DPD+3, DPD+7).
  • Provide repayment options to improve the borrower experience.
  • Accurately log all payment information, customer interactions, agreements, and outcomes in internal systems.
  • Support the team with day-to-day operational tasks related to collections.
  • Escalate cases per internal policies and flag recurring issues, customer objections, or process gaps to the Collections Specialist.
  • Prepare daily and weekly reports on recovery rates, DPD trends, and case resolutions, generating actionable insights to improve collection strategies.
  • Automate repetitive tasks using tools like SQL to identify inefficiencies and implement workflows that improve process efficiency.


What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.


But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

Por vermos a potência do esporte em todas as suas expressões, trabalhamos juntos com garra e energia para construir o primeiro ecossistema de esporte do mundo, reunindo diversas possibilidades para que as pessoas sejam envolvidas e impactadas pelo poder de se movimentar. title: Senior Portfolio Manager
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America.

We originate more than R$700M per year in B2B credit to Brazilian SMEs through CrediPay , our embedded finance platform. We operate in a segment where traditional financial infrastructure is limited, building proprietary credit intelligence and risk frameworks that do not yet exist in this market.

By combining structured capital markets solutions with real-time credit decisioning, we enable marketplaces and suppliers to offer seamless payment terms to their buyers, while we manage risk, pricing, and capital efficiency behind the scenes.

We are not a traditional lender. We are building the risk engine that powers scalable B2B commerce in Brazil.


Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.


About the job

We are looking for a Senior Portfolio Manager to take end-to-end ownership of portfolio performance and Cost of Risk outcomes. This position reports directly to the Head of Risk.

You will steer portfolio mix and concentration risk, continuously improve provisioning and loss forecasting accuracy, and design risk-adjusted pricing frameworks that enable disciplined but ambitious GTM growth. This is a senior individual contributor role with direct commercial impact and close collaboration across GTM, Treasury, and Collections.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in credit risk, portfolio management, or structured lending
  • Advanced SQL required; Python strongly preferred
  • Proven ownership of Cost of Risk (CoR) and portfolio performance
  • Strong understanding of credit cycles, concentration risk, and sector deterioration
  • Hands-on experience with provisioning models (e.g., IFRS9) and expected loss methodologies
  • Experience building risk-adjusted pricing frameworks
  • Strong commercial judgment — able to enable growth while protecting downside risk
  • Experience working closely with collections or recovery teams
  • Clear communicator, able to translate portfolio insights into business steering decisions
  • Experience with structured vehicles (e.g., FIDC) preferred


Responsibilities

  • Own portfolio steering across channels, sectors, ratings, and accounts
  • Monitor large exposures and concentration risk
  • Steer origination mix to balance growth and profitability
  • Deliver Cost of Risk in line or better than budget
  • Own and improve provisioning logic and expected loss methodologies
  • Reduce variance between expected and realised losses
  • Work closely with Collections to incorporate recovery insights into forecasting assumptions
  • Own risk-adjusted pricing logic for new and existing proposals
  • Partner with GTM to structure commercially competitive yet disciplined offers
  • Build scalable pricing and steering tooling to support faster decision-making
  • Align portfolio strategy with treasury constraints and capital efficiency


What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Analista de processos
description:
Descrição da Empresa

Ao se juntar à CRG Gestão, você não será apenas mais um número, você fará parte de uma equipe de alta performance.


Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de:

•Inovar na Prática: Trabalhar com tecnologias de ponta e desenvolver soluções que estão redefinindo o futuro da contabilidade no varejo.

•Crescimento Acelerado: Oferecemos um ambiente que valoriza o aprendizado contínuo e o desenvolvimento profissional, com claras oportunidades de crescimento na carreira.

•Cultura de Impacto: Fazer parte de um time que se preocupa genuinamente com o sucesso dos clientes e celebra cada vitória como se fosse sua.

•Ambiente Dinâmico: Somos conectados, rápidos e integrados. Se você prospera em ambientes que exigem agilidade e pensamento crítico, aqui é o seu lugar.

Buscamos profissionais que não tenham medo de desafios, que sejam proativos e que compartilhem da nossa paixão por transformar o varejo. Se você quer construir uma carreira sólida e fazer a diferença, venha fazer parte da CRG Gestão.

Estamos prontos para o futuro. E você?



Sobre a Vaga

Buscamos um(a) Analista de Processos Sênior com visão sistêmica, capacidade analítica apurada e experiência consolidada em mapeamento, modelagem e melhoria de processos. O profissional atuará de forma estratégica e independente, liderando iniciativas de transformação de processos e contribuindo diretamente para a eficiência operacional da organização.



Mapeamento e Modelagem de Processos

•      Mapear, documentar e modelar processos de negócio ponta a ponta utilizando notações como BPMN 2.0.

•      Realizar diagnósticos de situação atual (AS-IS) e propor arquiteturas de situação futura (TO-BE).

•      Manter o repositório de processos atualizado e acessível às áreas envolvidas.


Análise e Melhoria Contínua

•      Identificar gargalos, redundâncias e oportunidades de melhoria nos processos mapeados.

•      Conduzir análises de causa raiz (RCA) e propor planos de ação estruturados.

•      Aplicar metodologias como Lean, Six Sigma, BPM, Kaizen e outras abordagens de melhoria contínua.

•      Mensurar impactos das melhorias por meio de indicadores de desempenho (KPIs).


Gestão de Projetos de Transformação

•      Liderar e coordenar projetos de redesenho e automação de processos, da concepção à implementação.

•      Gerenciar stakeholders, cronogramas e entregas, garantindo alinhamento com as diretrizes estratégicas.

•      Facilitar workshops, entrevistas e reuniões de levantamento de requisitos com áreas de negócio.


Colaboração e Governança

•      Atuar como referência técnica em processos para as demais áreas da empresa.

•      Apoiar iniciativas de transformação digital e implementação de sistemas (ERP, CRM, RPA, etc.).

•      Garantir conformidade dos processos com normas, políticas internas e regulamentações externas.

•      Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e apresentações executivas sobre o desempenho dos processos.



Requisitos


Formação

•      Graduação em Administração, Engenharia de Produção, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

•      Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Processos, Lean, Projetos ou áreas afins (desejável).


Experiência

•      Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência com análise e gestão de processos.

•      Histórico comprovado de liderança em projetos de melhoria de processos de médio a grande porte.

•      Experiência com mapeamento em ferramentas especializadas (ex: Bizagi, Aris, Visio, Lucidchart).


Conhecimentos Técnicos

•      Domínio de BPMN 2.0 e notações de modelagem de processos.

•      Conhecimento em metodologias Lean, Six Sigma (Green ou Black Belt é diferencial), Agile e BPM.

•      Familiaridade com ferramentas de automação de processos (RPA, low-code).

•      Capacidade de análise de dados e elaboração de dashboards (Excel avançado, Power BI ou similar).


Competências Comportamentais

•      Visão sistêmica e orientação para resultados.

•      Capacidade de comunicação e influência junto a diferentes níveis hierárquicos.

•      Proatividade, senso de dono e autonomia para condução de projetos.

•      Habilidade para facilitar grupos e gerir conflitos.

•      Organização, atenção a detalhes e pensamento analítico.


Diferenciais

•      Certificação em BPM (CBPP), Six Sigma Black Belt ou PMP/PMI.

•      Experiência com transformação digital e implementação de sistemas ERP/CRM.

•      Conhecimento em automação com ferramentas RPA (UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Power Automate).

•      Inglês intermediário ou avançado.

title: LATAM-Focused Research Intern
description:
About BCP Securities Group

Founded in 1989, BCP Securities, Inc. is an American brokerage and investment bank focused on fixed income in emerging markets. Headquartered in Greenwich, Connecticut, with offices in strategic cities such as Rio de Janeiro, Miami, Los Angeles, Madrid, Mexico City, and Singapore, BCP is a global reference in customized financial solutions. Recognized for its excellence and ethical commitment, the company offers innovative and effective services to meet the needs of clients around the world.

Workplace: Rio de Janeiro, 100% on-site Contract Type: Internship

Position Description

We are looking for a motivated and curious Research Intern to join our Research team, with a focus on Latin America’s, particularly Argentina’s, macroeconomic and financial environment . This position is ideal for students who are eager to learn and develop their skills in economic and financial research.

The selected candidate must be native or fluent in Spanish and English (mandatory) and will support the research team in conducting studies, preparing financial reports, and assisting senior analysts in day-to-day activities.


Please note: Resumes will only be accepted if written English. Applications submitted in Portuguese will not be considered .

Main Responsibilities

·      Support the preparation of financial reports on companies and the monitoring of key economic and financial indicators.

·      Assist in preparing summaries and basic analyses of market trends, economic projections, and corporate earnings.

·      Help monitor economic events, public policy changes, and macroeconomic data that may impact financial markets.

·      Track the performance and movements of financial assets.

·      Assist in the development of financial models for company valuation, under the guidance of senior analysts.

·      Support data collection, organization, and basic analysis.

·      Assist with administrative and operational tasks such as organizing meetings, reports, and presentation materials.

·      Collaborate in the preparation of materials for internal use and for investor or market communications.

Requirements

·      Fluent Spanish and fluent English (mandatory).

·      Currently pursuing a degree in Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, Accounting, or related fields.

·      Basic understanding of financial concepts such as financial statements, company valuation, and financial instruments.

·      Ability to read and interpret financial statements and corporate reports.

·      Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with attention to detail.

·      Good Excel skills (formulas, basic financial modeling).

·      Clear and structured written communication skills.

·      Willingness to learn, curiosity about financial markets, and interest in economic trends and global events.

Differentials

·      Previous internship or academic experience in finance, economics, or capital markets.

·      Familiarity with financial information platforms such as Bloomberg or Reuters.

·      Knowledge of basic programming or data analysis tools (e.g., Python, VBA, Power BI).

Benefits

·      Hands-on learning experience in a global company with a strong presence in the fixed income market.

·      Exposure to macroeconomic analysis, company research, and financial markets in LatAm.

·      Continuous learning, mentoring, and professional development.

·      Collaborative, dynamic, and supportive work environment.

description:
The Company:

Our technologies are shaping the production and people-related ecosystems to become increasingly connected and autonomous — ensuring a scalable, sustainable future.

Hexagon’s Mining division solves surface and underground mine challenges with proven technologies for planning, operations, and safety.


Hexagon (Nasdaq Stockholm: HEXA B) has approximately 24,000 employees in 50 countries and net sales of approximately 5.5bn USD. Learn more at hexagon.com and follow us @HexagonAB.

Purpose of Position:


Hexagon Mining develops intelligent collision avoidance systems for large vehicles used mainly in open-pit mining. Its products integrate satellite navigation, digital radio, multiple sensors and actuation systems as well as sophisticated algorithms to reliably predict dangerous scenarios and prevent accidents. It employs approx. 100 R&D staff in several attractive international locations. The software developer will join the team to develop this solution.


Major Areas of Responsibility:

  • Design, develop and support our server backend services and client tools used for the current and next generation of our collision avoidance and safety system.
  • Collaborate closely with the hardware, firmware, and backend service development teams to realize new integrated solutions.
  • Assist the product-introduction team and gain first-hand experience with our products.
  • Bring in innovative ideas for further development.


Knowledge and Experience - Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Control and Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering or equivalent;
  • Experience in C and C++ on embedded or Linux systems;
  • MQTT and other IoT related protocols, networking technologies in general, and related network security aspects;
  • Full professional English proficiency;
  • Team oriented and able to work independently;
  • Positive working attitude and good common sense to understand business requirements;
  • Willing to travel overseas occasionally;


Knowledge and Experience - Desired:

  • Web technologies, React.js.
  • Knowledge of OpenWRT and Yocto
  • Knowledge of additional high-level language, e.g., Python, C#.
  • Development and/or maintenance of software for safety-critical, automotive, real-time or control systems
  • Development of localization, navigation, or perception systems based on technologies such as GNSS, radio, UWB, automotive radars, and IMUs.
  • Implementation of CAN, Ethernet, I2C, RS-232 or SPI-based drivers.
  • Functional Safety.
  • Experience with Test-Driven Design, Continuous Integration, and agile development processes (e.g., Scrum).


Travel:

  • 5-10%


Benefits:

  • Health plan
  • Comprehensive health program (psychological, nutritional, legal, financial, and social assistance)
  • Wellhub (Gym)
  • Life insurance
  • Meal/food allowance
  • Dental plan
  • Private pension plan


You will work on products that could revolutionize the mining industry in the next 5 years. Your colleagues consist of highly qualified and open-minded engineers from all over the world. Beside the developer career you will have the opportunity to develop into multiple directions like project management, product management, customer support and sales.


Join our team as a software developer and make a significant impact on our clients' digital transformation initiatives. We offer a stimulating work environment, competitive compensation package, and opportunities for professional growth. Apply now and help shape the future of Hexagon’s technology solutions.

title: Técnico(a) de Serviços - RJ
description:

4) Análise de projetos e estudos técnicos de outras empresas, bem como a emissão de Pareceres Técnicos (PATEC) de equipamentos e serviços que envolvam equipamento Emerson;

5) Serviços para configuração, programação e atualização (i.e. softwares, ladder, hardware, firmware, etc) dos Sistemas de Automação Emerson das Instalações de Produção da PETROBRAS, englobando computadores, redes de comunicação de dados e equipamentos de controle e intertravamento, tais como controladores lógicos programáveis da Emerson (PACSystems RX3i, Versamax, Series 9030 e 9070);

8) Realizar auditoria técnica nos equipamentos e aplicativos do fabricante, asim como gerenciamento e planejamento de sobressalentes e estoque de equipamentos dos Sistemas de Automação Industrial Emerson;

9) Comissionamento de novas tecnologias para os sistemas Emerson de Automação Industrial.

Quem você é:

Você distingue prontamente entre o que é relevante e o que é irrelevante para compreender situações complexas. Você encontra pontos em comum e conduz as coisas para o consenso, garantindo que todos se sintam ouvidos. Você utiliza insights dos clientes para impulsionar e orientar o desenvolvimento de novas ofertas. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam constantemente.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Formação Técnica em Automação;
  • Ter experiência comprovada na área de automação industrial, sendo 2 anos na área de óleo e gás (offshore);
  • Capacidade de interpretar especificações, programas e desenhos técnicos de sistemas de automação;
  • Conhecimento avançado no pacote MS Office;
  • Desejável conhecimento do portfólio de produtos da Emerson, tais como: PACSystems RX3i, VersaMax, QuickPanel+, Machine Edition etc;
  • Capacidade de especificar, dar suporte e manutenção, e elaborar arquiteturas de redes de automação industrial envolvendo switches, firewalls e rádios industriais;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho embarcado em plataformas de petróleo, no regime de trabalho 14 x 14;
  • Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro – RJ;
  • Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado.

Nossa Cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Sobre a Agropalma

A Agropalma é uma empresa brasileira reconhecida em todo o mundo como referência na produção sustentável de soluções com óleo de palma. Sua trajetória começou em 1982, no município de Tailândia (PA), e sua atuação perfaz toda a cadeia produtiva, desde a produção de mudas até o óleo refinado, gorduras especiais e produtos de alto valor agregado, incluindo linhas orgânicas.

Atualmente, a empresa conta com seis indústrias de extração de óleo bruto, duas refinarias e um terminal de exportação alfandegado, empregando cerca de 5 mil colaboradores. A Agropalma também foi pioneira em implementar, há mais de duas décadas, um programa de Agricultura Familiar com palma, beneficiando mais de 300 agricultores parceiros. Guiada pelo compromisso com o planeta e com as pessoas, a empresa segue avançando em práticas que tornam a palma sustentável uma referência brasileira.

description:

Estamos estruturando uma iniciativa estratégica de transformação do modelo operacional de tecnologia em uma organização de grande porte, com impacto direto na forma como a empresa desenvolve, entrega e sustenta produtos digitais.

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 etapas:


- Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

- Mobilidade Interna: Você quer um novo rumo profissional? Aqui dentro de casa temos diversas opções diferentes e o programa de mobilidade interna, que te permite mudar de área, por exemplo.

- Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

- Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


  • E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Previdência Privada; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

  • Design and implement deployment pipelines using tools like Jenkins, Gitlab, Ansible, Puppet, or similar to automate building, testing, and deployment processes
  • Manage and maintain the infrastructure for deployment pipelines, including servers, databases, load balancers, and other resources
  • Monitor the performance of applications deployed in production environments and troubleshoot any issues that arise
  • Ensure the security and compliance of the deployment process and applications, including implementing security measures such as SSL certificates, firewalls, and intrusion detection systems
  • Collaborate with developers to understand requirements, ensure alignment with the development process, and support successful deployment
  • Continuously improve deployment processes through automation, identifying and implementing opportunities for efficiency gains
  • Provide support to customers and end-users as needed, including troubleshooting and resolving issues related to deployed applications
  • Work with cross-functional teams to ensure the successful and timely deployment of software applications
  • Participate in on-call rotations to provide 24/7 support for our platform
  • Have the ability and flexibility to work with teams globally, across time zones


What you’ll have


  • 5+ years of experience in a deployment role and a Masters Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Industrial Engineering, Engineering Management OR 7+ years of experience in a deployment role with a Bachelor’s degree.
  • Certification in any of the following: AWS, Azure, GCP or K8
  • Experience deploying and maintaining applications in any one of the clouds (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  • Experience with cloud-based environments like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
  • Experience with Dockers or similar and experience with Kubernetes or similar
  • Strong technical skills in automation, continuous integration, and deployment practices
  • Working knowledge with Jenkins, Ansible, Terraform, etc.
  • Administration of databases (MS SQL, Mongo)
  • Working knowledge with Linux and Windows operating systems


What We Offer


  • Competitive Salary – We recognize and reward talent.
  • Tech Tools – Choose a Windows or PC laptop, whatever helps you work best.
  • Flexible Work – Work from home two days a week—less commuting, more time for what matters.
  • Supportive Team – Work alongside a diverse, talented team you can learn from every day.
  • Diversity & Inclusion – We celebrate our international workforce and value different perspectives.
  • Food & Drink – Enjoy healthy snacks, fresh fruit, teas, and coffees.


How the process works


  • Apply – Submit your application by clicking the Link below.
  • Initial Contact – Our recruiter will connect with you via video or phone call to discuss the role and understand your background.
  • Online Assessment – (If Applicable)
  • During the interview phase, you will meet with the technical panel for 60 minutes. We will contact you after the interview to let you know if we’d like to progress your application.
  • Tech Round 1 – An initial technical discussion to evaluate your skills and expertise.
  • Tech Round 2 – A deeper technical assessment to understand your approach and proficiency.
  • Managerial Round – A conversation with the hiring manager to evaluate collaboration, team fit, and growth potential.
  • HR Round – A final discussion on company culture, expectations, and career progression.


More about us…


At o9, transparency and open communication are at the core of our culture. Collaboration thrives across all levels—hierarchy, distance, or function never limit innovation or teamwork. Beyond work, we encourage volunteering opportunities, social impact initiatives, and diverse cultural celebrations.


With a $3.7 billion valuation and a global presence across Dallas, Amsterdam, Barcelona, Madrid, London, Paris, Tokyo, Seoul, and Munich, o9 is among the fastest-growing technology companies in the world. Through our aim10x vision, we are committed to AI-powered management, driving 10x improvements in enterprise decision-making. Our Enterprise Knowledge Graph enables businesses to anticipate risks, adapt to market shifts, and gain real-time visibility. By automating millions of decisions and reducing manual interventions by up to 90%, we empower enterprises to drive profitable growth, reduce inefficiencies, and create lasting value.


o9 is an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, ensuring a fair and unbiased hiring process. Join us as we continue our growth journey!

title: Analista de Desenvolvimento Humano - Vaga inclusiva PCD
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho


  • Atuar como responsável pelo acompanhamento dos colaboradores alocados nos clientes Dexian. O acompanhamento será remoto/presencial e através da plataforma DexianConnect.
  • Realizar e conduzir o processo de Onborading, inclusive atualizando a apresentação, conforme mudanças ocorram na empresa.
  • Acompanhar processos administrativos dos profissionais alocados (esclarecimento dúvidas sobre rotinas de RH, fechamento de ponto, férias, alinhamento de horários, orientações diversas, etc).

  • Estar em interação com as áreas de negócio da Dexian (Comercial, DP e R&S para que estejam sempre atualizados das informações levantadas sobre os colaboradores nos clientes).
  • Elaborar e manter atualizado mensalmente o Radar de Monitoramento de consultores e envio por e-mail para equipe comercial.
  • Conduz o processo de de off-boarding dos consultores.
  • Elaboração de políticas da área de DH.
  • Atuar na plataforma DexianConnect junto aos consultores para engajamento nas ações de celebração, acompanhamento dos comunicados, pesquisas, registros de 1:1, monitoramento da realização do Onboarding e realização da Avaliação do Período de Experiência (autoavaliação do consultor) dentro do prazo e PDI´s.


O que você precisa ter

  • Formação superior completa Psicologia, Gestão em Recursos Humanos, Administração ou áreas afins.
  • Desejável Pós-graduação em RH.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação híbrida e para realizar visitas em clientes.
  • Ter bom domínio Pacote Office.
  • Desejável inglês em nível intermediário/avançado .


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Demonstrar vontade de aprender e conhecer.
  • Ter boa adaptação e flexibilidade, uma vez que irá atuar com diversos clientes e perfis.
  • Ser ágil, dinâmico e proativo.
  • Apresentar resiliência para lidar com imprevistos e mudanças.
  • Ter capacidade de análise de dados e proposição de melhorias e planos de ação.
  • Capacidade, maturidade e autonomia para tomar decisões dentro do seu escopo de atuação.



Onde você vai trabalhar?

Celebramos a troca, relações e o poder do contato. São Paulo - SP - Regime Híbrido

Benefícios para você

* Vale Refeição

* Vale Alimentação

* Assistência Médica

* Assistência Odontológica

* Seguro de Vida

* Gym Pass

* Auxílio Pet


Além disso, oferecemos :

title: Pessoa Assistente de Contabilidade
description:
Sobre Barentz


A Barentz é uma distribuidora líder global de ingredientes de alto desempenho para ciências biológicas. A empresa oferece ingredientes e especialidades dos principais fabricantes em todo o mundo, bem como suporte técnico de valor agregado, incluindo pré-mistura, mistura, formulação de ingredientes e testes de ingredientes em seus centros de formulação e laboratórios de aplicações de última geração na região EMEA, Américas e Ásia-Pacífico.


Fundada em 1953, a Barentz opera em mais de 70 países, com forte presença na Europa e na América do Norte e uma rede em rápido crescimento na América Latina e na Ásia-Pacífico. Com um volume de negócios de 2,5 mil milhões de euros, a empresa emprega mais de 2.500 pessoas em todo o mundo e serve mais de 25.000 clientes. Para mais informações visite nosso site: .


Estamos em busca de uma Pessoa Assistente de Contabilidade para fazer parte do nosso time de Contabilidade.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Garantir precisão e qualidade nos lançamentos contábeis em ambiente de alto volume transacional.

  • Conferir integrações contábil-fiscal e contábil-financeira no ERP.
  • Apoiar na apuração de impostos e obrigações acessórias, quando aplicável.
  • Registrar e controlar documentos contábeis relacionados a compras, vendas, despesas e pagamentos.
  • Organizar e manter arquivo físico e digital de documentos contábeis e fiscais.
  • Dar suporte a auditorias internas e externas, providenciando documentos e esclarecimentos quando solicitado.
  • Auxiliar na composição de saldos de contas para relatórios contábil-financeiros.
  • Cumprir normas internas de compliance, controles internos e políticas da companhia.


Requisitos e qualificações


O que você precisa ter:

  • Ensino técnico completo ou superior cursando em Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pacote Office intermediário (principalmente Excel).
  • Conhecimento em rotinas contábeis e fechamento mensal.

O que gostaríamos que você tivesse:

  • Inglês – Básico ou intermediário;

  • Noções de controles internos e compliance.
  • Conhecimento em TOTVS Protheus (diferencial).


Modelo de Trabalho - CLT - Rotina presencial.

Local: Avenida Angélica, 2220, Nono andar, Consolação, São Paulo, SP, Brasil.

Vale Refeição/Alimentação no Cartão Ifood Benefícios, para você gastar como preferir, no crédito.
